messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your should-cost estimate and the proposed volume of 23,400 units over 24 months. 

We quote a price of €33.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.70 per unit. 

As a matter of policy, we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation (2)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your revised offer and your acceptance of the 42-day lead time. In response to your adjustment, we can reduce our price to €33.20 per unit for this package. Further price reductions are not feasible under these parameters.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our offer comprises a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. 

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 42 days: a price of €33.20 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. 

This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
